classification_basis: accepted operational-v1 obligations replay unchanged; this package adds trusted-free insert_tail/CopyOnDrop refinement

insert_tail_correspondence.proof_rule: field-complete well-founded induction on sift - begin, followed by entry-point lifting
valid_domains: 0 <= begin <= sift; gap == sift + 1; gap < sequence_len

source_order: initial comparison before moving the tail identity
move sift into the current gap
advance the guard destination to sift
decrement sift before the next comparison
lookup callback observations at the current pre-call state
commit callback next state before panic propagation
restore the temporary identity at the current gap on stop or panic
